title: Widgets: Add Content Blocks to Your Pages | Orchard Core
description:
A page often needs a block of text or a quote in a place its own fields do not reach, such as the footer. Writing that block into the theme means a developer for every change.

Widgets are content items that a theme shows in named zones. The Widgets module lets each item of a content type choose its own widgets, and you edit them in the admin like any other content.

In this video:
• What a widget is, and what a zone is
• Where the Widgets feature is turned on
• Widget types: content types with the Widget stereotype
• Allowing widgets on a content type with the WidgetsList part
• Adding widgets to the zones of a page
• Moving and removing widgets
